corrected_deduplication_facts.what_was_wrong: An earlier statement in this engagement claimed a shared lead_id or transaction_id would deduplicate 'LP Submit Lead Forms' against 'WC Lead'. THAT IS INCORRECT and is retracted.
corrected_deduplication_facts.how_google_actually_dedupes: order_id / transaction_id deduplicates only WITHIN a single conversion action. Two different conversion actions each record independently and no shared identifier links them.
corrected_deduplication_facts.why_merging_is_impossible_here: Offline uploads require a conversion action of type UPLOAD_CLICKS or UPLOAD_CALLS. Verified from the API: 6885463625 is WEBPAGE, 6885576934 is WEBSITE_CALL and 1068114183 is AD_CALL, so NONE of them can receive a WhatConverts upload. Only 7643656486 (UPLOAD_CLICKS) and 7643656075 (UPLOAD_CALLS) can. The two form signals therefore cannot be merged into one action.
corrected_deduplication_facts.enhanced_conversions_note: customer.conversion_tracking_setting.enhanced_conversions_for_leads_enabled is TRUE and accepted_customer_data_terms is TRUE. Enhanced Conversions for Leads DOES supplement an existing web action using hashed first-party identifiers, but it is Google's own matching mechanism for the SAME action. It does not merge a third-party upload action with a tag action.
corrected_deduplication_facts.the_only_reliable_control: Exactly ONE conversion action may be Primary AND included in the conversions metric per real-world lead event. That is what both plans below implement.
